title: Network Device Configuration Documentation Record
description: Schema for normalized network configuration documentation across multiple vendors

vendor.description: Vendor name (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, etc.)

concept_summary.description: 2-4 sentence plain-language explanation of the feature (paraphrased)

cli_mode_context.description: How to enter configuration mode for this feature

example_commands.description: Multi-line CLI block showing realistic, generic configuration example

verification_commands.description: Commands used to verify the configuration

source_url.description: Exact documentation page(s) used as source

not_available.description: True if topic documentation is not accessible for this vendor/version

reason.description: Reason why topic is not available (required when not_available=true)

deprecated.description: True if the commands/feature are deprecated or EoL

unverified.description: True if command syntax could not be fully verified from source

last_verified_date.description: Date when this entry was extracted/verified
